facts.value: Architects in the 1859 competition for the Parliament buildings had just ten weeks to meet detailed requirements, according to Hill Notes.
facts.quote: given just ten weeks to meet detailed requirements

facts.value: After the 1849 Montreal fire destroyed the Parliament buildings and their library, the Ottawa library was insisted upon as a separate structure with fire-proof iron doors.
facts.quote: insisting that the new library be housed in a separate structure with fire-proof iron doors
